title: Hazaaron Zubane
artist: Amit Kamble, Prakruthi Angelina & Hemant Sharma

hinglish.verse1:
Saari srishti par
Tera adhikaar
Tu Rajadhiraaj hai Prabhu
Tujhse hai zameen
Tujhi se aasmaan
Jag ka tu maalik Prabhu
hinglish.pre_chorus:
Karte hain sajda
Ibaadat ho teri sadaa
hinglish.chorus:
Hazaaron zubaanein gaayen
Tera hi naam dohraayen
Yeshu tu pavitra hai
hinglish.verse2:
Unch neech ka
Na koi wajood
Tere rajya mein
Tere rajya mein
Har kisi ka hai
Swaagat yahan
Tere rajya mein
Tere rajya mein
hinglish.pre_chorus2:
Teri rehmat mein hi
Tu leta hai sabko kareeb
hinglish.chorus2:
Hazaaron zubaanein gaayen
Tera hi naam dohraayen
Yeshu tu pavitra hai
hinglish.bridge:
Shahon ka Shah hai tu Khuda
Tera na koi muqaabla
Tera hi takht rahe sabse uncha

seo_description: Hazaaron Zubane lyrics in Hindi and Hinglish by Amit Kamble, Prakruthi Angelina and Hemant Sharma - Nations of Worship.
